ayahs.tr: Ta, Seen, Meem.
ayahs.tl: Taa-Seeen-Meeem

ayahs.tr: These are the verses of the clear Book.
ayahs.tl: Tilka Aayaatul Kitaabil Mubeen

ayahs.ar: لَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعٌۭ نَّفْسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.tr: Perhaps, [O Muhammad], you would kill yourself with grief that they will not be believers.
ayahs.tl: La'allaka baakhi'un nafsaka allaa yakoonoo mu'mineen

ayahs.ar: إِن نَّشَأْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ءَايَةًۭ فَظَلَّتْ أَعْنَٰقُهُمْ لَهَا خَٰضِعِينَ
ayahs.tr: If We willed, We could send down to them from the sky a sign for which their necks would remain humbled.
ayahs.tl: In nashaa nunazzil 'alaihim minas samaaa'i Aayatan fazallat a'naaquhum lahaa khaadi'een

ayahs.ar: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مُحْدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِينَ
ayahs.tr: And no revelation comes to them anew from the Most Merciful except that they turn away from it.
ayahs.tl: Wa maa yaateehim min zikrim minar Rahmaani muhdasin illaa kaanoo 'anhu mu'rideen

ayahs.ar: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا۟ فَسَيَأْتِيهِمْ أَنۢبَٰٓؤُا۟ مَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
ayahs.tr: For they have already denied, but there will come to them the news of that which they used to ridicule.
ayahs.tl: Faqad kazzaboo fasa yaateehim ambaaa'u maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon

ayahs.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَمْ أَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۢ كَرِيمٍ
ayahs.tr: Did they not look at the earth - how much We have produced therein from every noble kind?
ayahs.tl: Awa lam yaraw ilal ardi kam ambatnaa feehaa min kulli zawjin kareem

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.tr: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
ayahs.tl: Inn fee zaalika la Aayah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen

ayahs.tr: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.tl: Wa inna Rabbaka la Huwal 'Azeezur Raheem

ayahs.ar: وَإِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱئْتِ ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.tr: And [mention] when your Lord called Moses, [saying], "Go to the wrongdoing people -
ayahs.tl: Wa iz naadaa Rabbuka Moosaaa ani'-til qawmaz zaalimeen

ayahs.tr: The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear Allah?"
ayahs.tl: Qawma Fir'awn; alaa yattaqoon

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ
ayahs.tr: He said, "My Lord, indeed I fear that they will deny me
ayahs.tl: Qaala Rabbi inneee akhaafu ai yukazziboon

ayahs.ar: وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِى وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِى فَأَرْسِلْ إِلَىٰ هَٰرُونَ
ayahs.tr: And that my breast will tighten and my tongue will not be fluent, so send for Aaron.
ayahs.tl: Wa yadeequ sadree wa laa yantaliqu lisaanee fa arsil ilaa Haaroon

ayahs.ar: وَلَهُمْ عَلَىَّ ذَنۢبٌۭ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقْتُلُونِ
ayahs.tr: And they have upon me a [claim due to] sin, so I fear that they will kill me."
ayahs.tl: Wa lahum 'alaiya zambun fa akhaafu ai yaqtuloon

ayahs.ar: قَالَ كَلَّا ۖ فَٱذْهَبَا بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسْتَمِعُونَ
ayahs.tr: [Allah] said, "No. Go both of you with Our signs; indeed, We are with you, listening.
ayahs.tl: Qaala kallaa fazhabaa bi Aayaatinaaa innaa ma'akum mustami'oon

ayahs.ar: فَأْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.tr: Go to Pharaoh and say, 'We are the messengers of the Lord of the worlds,
ayahs.tl: Faatiyaa Fir'awna faqoolaaa innaa Rasoolu Rabbil 'aalameen

ayahs.tr: [Commanded to say], "Send with us the Children of Israel."'"
ayahs.tl: An arsil ma'anaa Baneee Israaa'eel

ayahs.ar: قَالَ أَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدًۭا وَلَبِثْتَ فِينَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ
ayahs.tr: [Pharaoh] said, "Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you remained among us for years of your life?
ayahs.tl: Qaala alam nurabbika feenaa waleedanw wa labista feenaa min 'umurika sineen

ayahs.ar: وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِى فَعَلْتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
ayahs.tr: And [then] you did your deed which you did, and you were of the ungrateful."
ayahs.tl: Wa fa'alta fa'latakal latee fa'alta wa anta minal kaafireen

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَآ إِذًۭا وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
ayahs.tr: [Moses] said, "I did it, then, while I was of those astray.
ayahs.tl: Qaala fa'altuhaaa izanw wa ana minad daaaleen

ayahs.ar: فَفَرَرْتُ مِنكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِى رَبِّى حُكْمًۭا وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
ayahs.tr: So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me wisdom and prophethood and appointed me [as one] of the messengers.
ayahs.tl: Fafarartu minkum lam maa khiftukum fawahaba lee Rabbee hukmanw wa ja'alanee minal mursaleen

ayahs.ar: وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌۭ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَىَّ أَنْ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
ayahs.tr: And is this a favor of which you remind me - that you have enslaved the Children of Israel?"
ayahs.tl: Wa tilka ni'matun tamun nuhaa 'alaiya an 'abbatta Baneee Israaa'eel

ayahs.tr: Said Pharaoh, "And what is the Lord of the worlds?"
ayahs.tl: Qaala Fir'awnu wa maa Rabbul 'aalameen

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
ayahs.tr: [Moses] said, "The Lord of the heavens and earth and that between them, if you should be convinced."
ayahs.tl: Qaala Rabbus samaawaati wal ardi wa maa bainahumaa in kuntum mooqineen

ayahs.tr: [Pharaoh] said to those around him, "Do you not hear?"
ayahs.tl: Qaala liman hawlahooo alaa tastami'oon

ayahs.tr: [Moses] said, "Your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers."
ayahs.tl: Qaala Rabbukum wa Rabbu aabaaa'ikumul awwaleen

ayahs.ar: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُونٌۭ
ayahs.tr: [Pharaoh] said, "Indeed, your 'messenger' who has been sent to you is mad."
ayahs.tl: Qaala inna Rasoolakumul lazee ursila ilaikum lamajnoon

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
ayahs.tr: [Moses] said, "Lord of the east and the west and that between them, if you were to reason."
ayahs.tl: Qaala Rabbul mashriqi wal maghribi wa maa baina humaa in kuntum ta'qiloon

ayahs.ar: قَالَ لَئِنِ ٱتَّخَذْتَ إِلَٰهًا غَيْرِى لَأَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمَسْجُونِينَ
ayahs.tr: [Pharaoh] said, "If you take a god other than me, I will surely place you among those imprisoned."
ayahs.tl: Qaala la'init takhazta ilaahan ghairee la aj'alannaka minal masjooneen

ayahs.tr: [Moses] said, "Even if I brought you proof manifest?"
ayahs.tl: Qaala awalw ji'tuka bishai'im mubeen

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَأْتِ بِهِۦٓ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.tr: [Pharaoh] said, "Then bring it, if you should be of the truthful."
ayahs.tl: Qaala faati biheee in kunta minas saadiqeen

ayahs.ar: فَأَلْقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ ثُعْبَانٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
ayahs.tr: So [Moses] threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent manifest.
ayahs.tl: Fa alqaa 'asaahu fa izaaa hiya su'baanum mubeen

ayahs.ar: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُۥ فَإِذَا هِىَ بَيْضَآءُ لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ
ayahs.tr: And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white for the observers.
ayahs.tl: Wa naza'a yadahoo faizaa hiya baidaaa'u linnaa zireen

ayahs.ar: قَالَ لِلْمَلَإِ حَوْلَهُۥٓ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسَٰحِرٌ عَلِيمٌۭ
ayahs.tr: [Pharaoh] said to the eminent ones around him, "Indeed, this is a learned magician.
ayahs.tl: Qaala lilmala-i hawlahooo inna haazaa lasaahirun 'aleem

ayahs.ar: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ
ayahs.tr: He wants to drive you out of your land by his magic, so what do you advise?"
ayahs.tl: Yureedu ai yukhrijakum min ardikum bisihrihee famaazaa taamuroon

ayahs.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبْعَثْ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ
ayahs.tr: They said, "Postpone [the matter of] him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers
ayahs.tl: Qaalooo arjih wa akhaahu wab'as filmadaaa'ini haashireen

ayahs.tr: Who will bring you every learned, skilled magician."
ayahs.tl: Yaatooka bikulli sah haarin 'aleem

ayahs.tr: So the magicians were assembled for the appointment of a well-known day.
ayahs.tl: Fa jumi'as saharatu limeeqaati Yawmim ma'loom

ayahs.tr: And it was said to the people, "Will you congregate
ayahs.tl: Wa qeela linnaasi hal antum mujtami'oon

ayahs.ar: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ
ayahs.tr: That we might follow the magicians if they are the predominant?"
ayahs.tl: La'allanaa nattabi'us saharata in kaanoo humul ghaalibeen

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُوا۟ لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ
ayahs.tr: And when the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh, "Is there indeed for us a reward if we are the predominant?"
ayahs.tl: Falammaa jaaa'as saharatu qaaloo li Fir'awna a'inna lanaa la ajjran in kunnaa nahnul ghaalibeen

ayahs.ar: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًۭا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
ayahs.tr: He said, "Yes, and indeed, you will then be of those near [to me]."
ayahs.tl: Qaala na'am wa innakum izal laminal muqarrabeen

ayahs.ar: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلْقُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ
ayahs.tr: Moses said to them, "Throw whatever you will throw."
ayahs.tl: Qaala lahum Moosaaa alqoo maaa antum mulqoon

ayahs.ar: فَأَلْقَوْا۟ حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْغَٰلِبُونَ
ayahs.tr: So they threw their ropes and their staffs and said, "By the might of Pharaoh, indeed it is we who are predominant."
ayahs.tl: Fa alqaw hibaalahum wa 'isiyyahum wa qaaloo bi'izzati Fir'awna innaa lanahnul ghaaliboon

ayahs.ar: فَأَلْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ
ayahs.tr: Then Moses threw his staff, and at once it devoured what they falsified.
ayahs.tl: Fa alqaa Moosaa 'asaahu fa izaa hiya talqafu maa yaafikoon

ayahs.tr: So the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allah].
ayahs.tl: Fa ulqiyas saharatu saajideen

ayahs.tr: They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds,
ayahs.tl: Qaalooo aamannaa bi Rabbil 'aalameen

ayahs.tr: The Lord of Moses and Aaron."
ayahs.tl: Rabbi Moosaa wa Haaroon

ayahs.ar: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ ۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَٰفٍۢ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.tr: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed Moses before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic, but you are going to know. I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all."
ayahs.tl: Qaala aamantum lahoo qabla an aazana lakum innahoo lakabeerukumul lazee 'alla makumus sihra falasawfa ta'lamoon; la uqatti'anna aidiyakum wa arjulakum min khilaafinw wa la usallibanna kum ajma'een

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا۟ لَا ضَيْرَ ۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ
ayahs.tr: They said, "No harm. Indeed, to our Lord we will return.
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo la daira innaaa ilaa Rabbinaa munqalliboon

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَٰيَٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.tr: Indeed, we aspire that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we were the first of the believers."
ayahs.tl: Innaa natma'u ai yaghfira lanaa Rabbunna khataa yaanaaa an kunnaaa awwalal mu'mineen

ayahs.ar: ۞ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِىٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
ayahs.tr: And We inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants; indeed, you will be pursued."
ayahs.tl: Wa awhainaaa ilaa Moosaaa an asri bi'ibaadeee innakum muttaba'oon

ayahs.tr: Then Pharaoh sent among the cities gatherers
ayahs.tl: Fa arsala Fir'awnu filmadaaa'ini haashireen

ayahs.tr: [And said], "Indeed, those are but a small band,
ayahs.tl: Inna haaa'ulaaa'i lashir zimatun qaleeloon

ayahs.tr: And indeed, they are enraging us,
ayahs.tl: Wa innahum lanaa laghaaa'izoon

ayahs.tr: And indeed, we are a cautious society... "
ayahs.tl: Wa innaa lajamee'un haaziroon

ayahs.tr: So We removed them from gardens and springs
ayahs.tl: Fa akhrajnaahum min Jannaatinw wa 'uyoon

ayahs.tr: And treasures and honorable station -
ayahs.tl: Wa kunoozinw wa ma qaamin kareem

ayahs.tr: Thus. And We caused to inherit it the Children of Israel.
ayahs.tl: Kazaalika wa awrasnaahaa Baneee Israaa'eel

ayahs.tr: So they pursued them at sunrise.
ayahs.tl: Fa atba'oohum mushriqeen

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ
ayahs.tr: And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Moses said, "Indeed, we are to be overtaken!"
ayahs.tl: Falammaa taraaa'al jam'aani qaala as haabu Moosaaa innaa lamudrakoon

ayahs.ar: قَالَ كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
ayahs.tr: [Moses] said, "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me."
ayahs.tl: Qaala kallaaa inna ma'iya Rabbee sa yahdeen

ayahs.ar: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ ۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍۢ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
ayahs.tr: Then We inspired to Moses, "Strike with your staff the sea," and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain.
ayahs.tl: Fa awhainaaa ilaa Moosaaa anidrib bi'asaakal bahra fanfalaqa fakaana kullu firqin kattawdil 'azeem

ayahs.tr: And We advanced thereto the pursuers.
ayahs.tl: Wa azlafnaa sammal aakhareen

ayahs.tr: And We saved Moses and those with him, all together.
ayahs.tl: Wa anjainaa Moosaa wa mam ma'ahooo ajma'een

ayahs.tr: Then We drowned the others.
ayahs.tl: Summa aghraqnal aakhareen

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.tr: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
ayahs.tl: Inna fee zaalika la Aayaah; wa maa kaana aksaru hu mu'mineen

ayahs.tr: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.tl: Wa inna Rabbaka la Huwal 'Azeezur Raheem

ayahs.tr: And recite to them the news of Abraham,
ayahs.tl: Watlu 'alaihim naba-a Ibraaheem

ayahs.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
ayahs.tr: When he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?"
ayahs.tl: Iz qaala li abeehi wa qawmihee maa ta'budoon

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا۟ نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًۭا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَٰكِفِينَ
ayahs.tr: They said, "We worship idols and remain to them devoted."
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo na'budu asnaaman fanazallu lahaa 'aakifeen

ayahs.tr: He said, "Do they hear you when you supplicate?
ayahs.tl: Qaala hal yasma'oona kum iz tad'oon

ayahs.tr: Or do they benefit you, or do they harm?"
ayahs.tl: Aw yanfa'oonakum aw yadurroon

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
ayahs.tr: They said, "But we found our fathers doing thus."
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo bal wajadnaaa aabaaa 'anaa kazaalika yaf'aloon

ayahs.tr: He said, "Then do you see what you have been worshipping,
ayahs.tl: Qaala afara 'aitum maa kuntum ta'budoon

ayahs.tr: You and your ancient forefathers?
ayahs.tl: Antum wa aabaaa'ukumul aqdamoon

ayahs.ar: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ لِّىٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.tr: Indeed, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the worlds,
ayahs.tl: Fa innahum 'aduwwwul leee illaa Rabbal 'aalameen

ayahs.tr: Who created me, and He [it is who] guides me.
ayahs.tl: Allazee khalaqanee fa Huwa yahdeen

ayahs.tr: And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink.
ayahs.tl: Wallazee Huwa yut'imunee wa yasqeen

ayahs.tr: And when I am ill, it is He who cures me
ayahs.tl: Wa izaa mardtu fahuwa yashfeen

ayahs.tr: And who will cause me to die and then bring me to life
ayahs.tl: Wallazee yumeetunee summa yuhyeen

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِى خَطِيٓـَٔتِى يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.tr: And who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense."
ayahs.tl: Wallazeee atma'u ai yaghfira lee khateee' atee Yawmad Deen

ayahs.ar: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًۭا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
ayahs.tr: [And he said], "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous.
ayahs.tl: Rabbi hab lee hukmanw wa alhiqnee bis saaliheen

ayahs.ar: وَٱجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍۢ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
ayahs.tr: And grant me a reputation of honor among later generations.
ayahs.tl: Waj'al lee lisaana sidqin fil aakhireen

ayahs.tr: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure.
ayahs.tl: Waj'alnee minw warasati Jannnatin Na'eem

ayahs.ar: وَٱغْفِرْ لِأَبِىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
ayahs.tr: And forgive my father. Indeed, he has been of those astray.
ayahs.tl: Waghfir li abeee innahoo kaana mind daalleen

ayahs.tr: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected -
ayahs.tl: Wa laa tukhzinee Yawma yub'asoon

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌۭ وَلَا بَنُونَ
ayahs.tr: The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children
ayahs.tl: Yawma laa yanfa'u maalunw wa laa banoon

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍۢ سَلِيمٍۢ
ayahs.tr: But only one who comes to Allah with a sound heart."
ayahs.tl: Illaa man atal laaha biqalbin saleem

ayahs.tr: And Paradise will be brought near [that Day] to the righteous.
ayahs.tl: Wa uzlifatil Jannatu lilmuttaqeen

ayahs.tr: And Hellfire will be brought forth for the deviators,
ayahs.tl: Wa burrizatil Jaheemu lilghaaween

ayahs.ar: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
ayahs.tr: And it will be said to them, "Where are those you used to worship
ayahs.tl: Wa qeela lahum aina maa kuntum ta'budoon

ayahs.ar: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ
ayahs.tr: Other than Allah? Can they help you or help themselves?"
ayahs.tl: Min doonil laahi hal yansuroonakum aw yantasiroon

ayahs.tr: So they will be overturned into Hellfire, they and the deviators
ayahs.tl: Fakubkiboo feehaa hum walghaawoon

ayahs.tr: And the soldiers of Iblees, all together.
ayahs.tl: Wa junoodu Ibleesa ajma'oon

ayahs.tr: They will say while they dispute therein,
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo wa hum feehaa yakkhtasimoon

ayahs.ar: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.tr: "By Allah, we were indeed in manifest error
ayahs.tl: Tallaahi in kunnaa lafee dalaalim mubeen

ayahs.tr: When we equated you with the Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.tl: Iz nusawweekum bi Rabbil 'aalameen

ayahs.tr: And no one misguided us except the criminals.
ayahs.tl: Wa maaa adallanaaa illal mujrimoon

ayahs.tr: So now we have no intercessors
ayahs.tl: Famaa lanaa min shaa fi'een

ayahs.tr: And not a devoted friend.
ayahs.tl: Wa laa sadeeqin hameem

ayahs.ar: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةًۭ فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.tr: Then if we only had a return [to the world] and could be of the believers... "
ayahs.tl: Falaw anna lanaa karratan fanakoona minal mu'mineen

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.tr: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
ayahs.tl: Inna fee zaalika la Aayatanw wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen

ayahs.tr: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.tl: Wa inna Rabbaka la Huwal 'Azeezur Raheem

ayahs.tr: The people of Noah denied the messengers
ayahs.tl: Kazzabat qawmu Noohinil Mursaleen

ayahs.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.tr: When their brother Noah said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?
ayahs.tl: Iz qaala lahum akhoohum Noohun alaa tattaqoon

ayahs.tr: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
ayahs.tl: Innee lakum Rasoolun ameen

ayahs.tr: So fear Allah and obey me.
ayahs.tl: Fattaqullaaha wa atee'oon

ayahs.ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.tr: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.tl: Wa maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa Rabbil 'aalameen

ayahs.tr: So fear Allah and obey me."
ayahs.tl: Fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon

ayahs.tr: They said, "Should we believe you while you are followed by the lowest [class of people]?"
ayahs.tl: Qaalooo anu'minu laka wattaba 'akal arzaloon

ayahs.ar: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِى بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.tr: He said, "And what is my knowledge of what they used to do?
ayahs.tl: Qaala wa maa 'ilmee bimaa kaanoo ya'maloon

ayahs.ar: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّى ۖ لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ
ayahs.tr: Their account is only upon my Lord, if you [could] perceive.
ayahs.tl: In hisaabuhum illaa 'alaa Rabbee law tash'uroon

ayahs.tr: And I am not one to drive away the believers.
ayahs.tl: Wa maaa ana bitaaridil mu'mineen

ayahs.tr: I am only a clear warner."
ayahs.tl: In ana illaa nazeerum mubeen

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْجُومِينَ
ayahs.tr: They said, "If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be of those who are stoned."
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo la'il lam tantahi yaa Noohu latakoonanna minal marjoomeen

ayahs.tr: He said, "My Lord, indeed my people have denied me.
ayahs.tl: Qaala Rabbi inna qawmee kazzaboon

ayahs.ar: فَٱفْتَحْ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًۭا وَنَجِّنِى وَمَن مَّعِىَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.tr: Then judge between me and them with decisive judgement and save me and those with me of the believers."
ayahs.tl: Faftab bainee wa bai nahum fat hanw wa najjinee wa mam ma'iya minal mu'mineen

ayahs.ar: فَأَنجَيْنَٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
ayahs.tr: So We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.
ayahs.tl: Fa anjainaahu wa mamma'ahoo fil fulkil mashhoon

ayahs.tr: Then We drowned thereafter the remaining ones.
ayahs.tl: Summa aghraqnaa ba'dul baaqeen

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.tr: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
ayahs.tl: Inna fee zaalika la Aayaah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen

ayahs.tr: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.tl: Wa inna Rabbaka la huwal 'Azeezur Raheem

ayahs.tr: 'Aad denied the messengers
ayahs.tl: Kazzabat 'Aadunil mursaleen

ayahs.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.tr: When their brother Hud said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?
ayahs.tl: Iz qaala lahum akhoohum Hoodun alaa tattaqoon

ayahs.tr: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
ayahs.tl: Innee lakum Rasoolun ameen

ayahs.tr: So fear Allah and obey me.
ayahs.tl: Fattaqullaaha wa atee'oon

ayahs.ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.tr: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.tl: Wa maa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa Rabbil 'aalameen

ayahs.tr: Do you construct on every elevation a sign, amusing yourselves,
ayahs.tl: Atabnoona bikulli ree'in aayatan ta'basoon

ayahs.tr: And take for yourselves palaces and fortresses that you might abide eternally?
ayahs.tl: Wa tattakhizoona masaani'a la'allakum takhludoon

ayahs.tr: And when you strike, you strike as tyrants.
ayahs.tl: Wa izaa batashtum batashtum jabbaareen

ayahs.tr: So fear Allah and obey me.
ayahs.tl: Fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon

ayahs.tr: And fear He who provided you with that which you know,
ayahs.tl: Wattaqul lazeee amad dakum bimaa ta'lamoon

ayahs.tr: Provided you with grazing livestock and children
ayahs.tl: Amaddakum bi an'aa minw wa baneen

ayahs.tr: And gardens and springs.
ayahs.tl: Wa jannaatinw wa 'uyoon

ayahs.ar: إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
ayahs.tr: Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."
ayahs.tl: Innee akhaafu 'alaikum 'azaaba Yawmin 'azeem

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْوَٰعِظِينَ
ayahs.tr: They said, "It is all the same to us whether you advise or are not of the advisors.
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo sawaaa'un 'alainaaa awa 'azta am lam takum minal waa'izeen

ayahs.tr: This is not but the custom of the former peoples,
ayahs.tl: In haazaaa illaa khuluqul awwaleen

ayahs.tr: And we are not to be punished."
ayahs.tl: Wa maa nahnu bimu 'azzabeen

ayahs.ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَٰهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.tr: And they denied him, so We destroyed them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
ayahs.tl: Fakazzaboohu fa ahlaknaahum; inna fee zaalika la aayah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen

ayahs.tr: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.tl: Wa inna Rabbaka la huwal 'Azeezur Raheem

ayahs.tr: Thamud denied the messengers
ayahs.tl: Kazzabat Samoodul mursaleen

ayahs.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.tr: When their brother Salih said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?
ayahs.tl: Iz qaala lahum akhoohum Saalihun alaa tattaqoon

ayahs.tr: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
ayahs.tl: Innee lakum Rasoolun ameen

ayahs.tr: So fear Allah and obey me.
ayahs.tl: Fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon

ayahs.ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.tr: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.tl: Wa maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa Rabbil 'aalameen

ayahs.tr: Will you be left in what is here, secure [from death],
ayahs.tl: Atutrakoona fee maa haahunnaaa aamineen

ayahs.tr: Within gardens and springs
ayahs.tl: Fee jannaatinw wa 'uyoon

ayahs.tr: And fields of crops and palm trees with softened fruit?
ayahs.tl: Wa zuroo inw wa nakhlin tal 'uhaa hadeem

ayahs.tr: And you carve out of the mountains, homes, with skill.
ayahs.tl: Wa tanhitoona minal jibaali buyootan faariheen

ayahs.tr: So fear Allah and obey me.
ayahs.tl: Fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon

ayahs.tr: And do not obey the order of the transgressors,
ayahs.tl: Wa laa tutee'ooo amral musrifeen

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ
ayahs.tr: Who cause corruption in the land and do not amend."
ayahs.tl: Allazeena yufsidoona fil ardi wa laa yuslihoon

ayahs.tr: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.
ayahs.tl: Qaalooo innamaa anta minal musahhareen

ayahs.ar: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.tr: You are but a man like ourselves, so bring a sign, if you should be of the truthful."
ayahs.tl: Maaa anta illaa basharum mislunaa faati bi Aayatin in kunta minas saadiqeen

ayahs.ar: قَالَ هَٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٌۭ لَّهَا شِرْبٌۭ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ
ayahs.tr: He said, "This is a she-camel. For her is a [time of] drink, and for you is a [time of] drink, [each] on a known day.
ayahs.tl: Qaala haazihee naaqatul lahaa shirbunw w alakum shirbu yawmim ma'loom

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍۢ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
ayahs.tr: And do not touch her with harm, lest you be seized by the punishment of a terrible day."
ayahs.tl: Wa laa tamassoohaa bisooo'in fa yaakhuzakum 'azaabu Yawmin 'Azeem

ayahs.tr: But they hamstrung her and so became regretful.
ayahs.tl: Fa'aqaroohaa fa asbahoo naadimeen

ayahs.ar: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.tr: And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
ayahs.tl: Fa akhazahumul 'azaab; inna fee zaalika la Aayah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum m'mineen

ayahs.tr: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.tl: Wa inna Rabbaka la Huwal 'Azeezur Raheem

ayahs.tr: The people of Lot denied the messengers
ayahs.tl: kazzabat qawmu Lootinil mursaleen

ayahs.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.tr: When their brother Lot said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?
ayahs.tl: Iz qaala lahum akhoohum Lootun alaa tattaqoon

ayahs.tr: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
ayahs.tl: Innee lakum rasoolun ameen

ayahs.tr: So fear Allah and obey me.
ayahs.tl: Fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon

ayahs.ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.tr: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.tl: Wa maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa Rabbil 'aalameen

ayahs.tr: Do you approach males among the worlds
ayahs.tl: Ataatoonaz zukraana minal 'aalameen

ayahs.ar: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُم مِّنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ عَادُونَ
ayahs.tr: And leave what your Lord has created for you as mates? But you are a people transgressing."
ayahs.tl: Wa tazaroona maa khalaqa lakum Rabbukum min azwaajikum; bal antum qawmun 'aadoon

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَٰلُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْرَجِينَ
ayahs.tr: They said, "If you do not desist, O Lot, you will surely be of those evicted."
ayahs.tl: Qaloo la'il lam tantahi yaa Lootu latakoonanna minal mukhrajeen

ayahs.tr: He said, "Indeed, I am, toward your deed, of those who detest [it].
ayahs.tl: Qaala innee li'amalikum minal qaaleen

ayahs.tr: My Lord, save me and my family from [the consequence of] what they do."
ayahs.tl: Rabbi najjjinee wa ahlee mimmmaa ya'maloon

ayahs.tr: So We saved him and his family, all,
ayahs.tl: Fanajjainaahu wa ahlahooo ajma'een

ayahs.tr: Except an old woman among those who remained behind.
ayahs.tl: Illaa 'ajoozan filghaabireen

ayahs.tr: Then We destroyed the others.
ayahs.tl: Summa dammarnal aa khareen

ayahs.ar: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًۭا ۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
ayahs.tr: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.
ayahs.tl: Wa amtarnaa 'alaihim mataran fasaaa'a matarul munzareen

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.tr: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
ayahs.tl: Inna fee zaalika la Aayah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen

ayahs.tr: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.tl: Wa inna Rabbaka la Huwal 'Azeezur Raheem

ayahs.tr: The companions of the thicket denied the messengers
ayahs.tl: Kazzaba As haabul Aykatil mursaleen

ayahs.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.tr: When Shu'ayb said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?
ayahs.tl: Iz qaala lahum Shu'aybun alaa tattaqoon

ayahs.tr: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
ayahs.tl: Innee lakum Rasoolun ameen

ayahs.tr: So fear Allah and obey me.
ayahs.tl: Fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon

ayahs.ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.tr: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.tl: Wa maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa Rabbil 'aalameen

ayahs.ar: ۞ أَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْسِرِينَ
ayahs.tr: Give full measure and do not be of those who cause loss.
ayahs.tl: Awful kaila wa laa takoonoo minal mukhsireen

ayahs.tr: And weigh with an even balance.
ayahs.tl: Wa zinoo bilqistaasil mustaqeem

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
ayahs.tr: And do not deprive people of their due and do not commit abuse on earth, spreading corruption.
ayahs.tl: Wa laa tabkhasun naasa ashyaaa 'ahum wa laa ta'saw fil ardi mufsideen

ayahs.tr: And fear He who created you and the former creation."
ayahs.tl: Wattaqul lazee khalaqakum waljibillatal awwaleen

ayahs.tr: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.
ayahs.tl: Qaalooo innamaa anta minal musahhareen

ayahs.ar: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
ayahs.tr: You are but a man like ourselves, and indeed, we think you are among the liars.
ayahs.tl: Wa maaa anta illaa basharum mislunaa wa innazunnuka laminal kaazibeen

ayahs.ar: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.tr: So cause to fall upon us fragments of the sky, if you should be of the truthful."
ayahs.tl: Fa asqit 'alainaa kisafam minas samaaa'i in kunta minas saadiqeen

ayahs.tr: He said, "My Lord is most knowing of what you do."
ayahs.tl: Qaala Rabbeee a'lamu bimaa ta'maloon

ayahs.ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
ayahs.tr: And they denied him, so the punishment of the day of the black cloud seized them. Indeed, it was the punishment of a terrible day.
ayahs.tl: Fakazzaboohu fa akhazahum 'azaabu Yawmiz zullah; innahoo kaana 'azaaba Yawmin 'Azeem

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.tr: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
ayahs.tl: Inna fee zaalika la Aayah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen

ayahs.tr: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.tl: Wa inna Rabbaka la huwal 'Azeezur Raheem

ayahs.tr: And indeed, the Qur'an is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.tl: Wa innahoo latanzeelu Rabbil 'aalameen

ayahs.tr: The Trustworthy Spirit has brought it down
ayahs.tl: Nazala bihir Roohul Ameen

ayahs.tr: Upon your heart, [O Muhammad] - that you may be of the warners -
ayahs.tl: 'Alaa qalbika litakoona minal munzireen

ayahs.tr: In a clear Arabic language.
ayahs.tl: Bilisaanin 'Arabiyyim mubeen

ayahs.tr: And indeed, it is [mentioned] in the scriptures of former peoples.
ayahs.tl: Wa innahoo lafee Zuburil awwaleen

ayahs.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ ءَايَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَٰٓؤُا۟ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
ayahs.tr: And has it not been a sign to them that it is recognized by the scholars of the Children of Israel?
ayahs.tl: Awalam yakul lahum Aayatan ai ya'lamahoo 'ulamaaa'u Baneee Israaa'eel

ayahs.tr: And even if We had revealed it to one among the foreigners
ayahs.tl: Wa law nazzalnaahu 'alaa ba'dil a'jameen

ayahs.ar: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.tr: And he had recited it to them [perfectly], they would [still] not have been believers in it.
ayahs.tl: Faqara ahoo 'alaihim maa kaanoo bihee mu'mineen

ayahs.tr: Thus have We inserted disbelief into the hearts of the criminals.
ayahs.tl: Kazaalika salaknaahu fee quloobil mujrimeen

ayahs.ar: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
ayahs.tr: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment.
ayahs.tl: Laa yu'minoona bihee hattaa yarawul 'azaabal aleem

ayahs.tr: And it will come to them suddenly while they perceive [it] not.
ayahs.tl: Fayaatiyahum baghtatanw wa hum laa yash'uroon

ayahs.tr: And they will say, "May we be reprieved?"
ayahs.tl: Fa yaqooloo hal nahnu munzaroon

ayahs.tr: So for Our punishment are they impatient?
ayahs.tl: Aafabi 'azaabinaa yasta'jiloon

ayahs.tr: Then have you considered if We gave them enjoyment for years
ayahs.tl: Aara'aita im matta'naahum sineen

ayahs.tr: And then there came to them that which they were promised?
ayahs.tl: Summa jaaa'ahum maa kaanoo yoo'adoon

ayahs.ar: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُمَتَّعُونَ
ayahs.tr: They would not be availed by the enjoyment with which they were provided.
ayahs.tl: Maaa aghnaaa 'anhum maa kaanoo yumaatoo'oon

ayahs.ar: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ
ayahs.tr: And We did not destroy any city except that it had warners
ayahs.tl: Wa maaa ahlaknaa min qaryatin illaa lahaa munziroon

ayahs.tr: As a reminder; and never have We been unjust.
ayahs.tl: Zikraa wa maa kunnaa zaalimeen

ayahs.tr: And the devils have not brought the revelation down.
ayahs.tl: Wa maa tanazzalat bihish Shayaateen

ayahs.tr: It is not allowable for them, nor would they be able.
ayahs.tl: Wa maa yambaghee lahum wa maa yastatee'oon

ayahs.tr: Indeed they, from [its] hearing, are removed.
ayahs.tl: Innahum 'anis sam'i lama'zooloon

ayahs.ar: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُعَذَّبِينَ
ayahs.tr: So do not invoke with Allah another deity and [thus] be among the punished.
ayahs.tl: Falaa tad'u ma'al laahi ilaahan aakhara fatakoona minal mu'azzabeen

ayahs.tr: And warn, [O Muhammad], your closest kindred.
ayahs.tl: Wa anzir 'asheeratakal aqrabeen

ayahs.ar: وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.tr: And lower your wing to those who follow you of the believers.
ayahs.tl: Wakhfid janaahaka limanit taba 'aka minal mu'mineen

ayahs.ar: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌۭ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.tr: And if they disobey you, then say, "Indeed, I am disassociated from what you are doing."
ayahs.tl: Fa in asawka faqul innee bareee'um mimmmaa ta'maloon

ayahs.tr: And rely upon the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
ayahs.tl: Wa tawakkal alal 'Azeezir Raheem

ayahs.tr: Who sees you when you arise
ayahs.tl: Allazee yaraaka heena taqoom

ayahs.tr: And your movement among those who prostrate.
ayahs.tl: Wa taqallubaka fis saajideen

ayahs.tr: Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
ayahs.tl: Innahoo Huwas Samee'ul 'Aleem

ayahs.ar: هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ
ayahs.tr: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?
ayahs.tl: Hal unabbi'ukum 'alaa man tanazzalush Shayaateen

ayahs.tr: They descend upon every sinful liar.
ayahs.tl: Tanazzalu 'alaa kulli affaakin aseem

ayahs.tr: They pass on what is heard, and most of them are liars.
ayahs.tl: Yulqoonas sam'a wa aksaruhum aaziboon

ayahs.tr: And the poets - [only] the deviators follow them;
ayahs.tl: Washshu 'araaa'u yattabi 'uhumul ghaawoon

ayahs.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِى كُلِّ وَادٍۢ يَهِيمُونَ
ayahs.tr: Do you not see that in every valley they roam
ayahs.tl: Alam tara annahum fee kulli waadiny yaheemoon

ayahs.tr: And that they say what they do not do? -
ayahs.tl: Wa annahum yaqooloona ma laa yaf'aloon

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَذَكَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًۭا وَٱنتَصَرُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا۟ ۗ وَسَيَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَىَّ مُنقَلَبٍۢ يَنقَلِبُونَ
ayahs.tr: Except those [poets] who believe and do righteous deeds and remember Allah often and defend [the Muslims] after they were wronged. And those who have wronged are going to know to what [kind of] return they will be returned.
ayahs.tl: Illal lazeena aamanoo w a'amilus saalihaati wa zakarul laaha kaseeranw wantasaroo mim ba'di maa zulimoo; wa saya'lamul lazeena zalamooo aiya munqalbiny yanqaliboon
